messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Tue 17 Nov
Renfe strike today (24h): Rodalies/Cercanías trains are running a reduced service.

TODAY · Tue 17 Nov

1. Homer El Mero Mero — Resurrección Tour
🕘 Tonight 21:00 · 📍 Sala La Nau, C/ d'Àlaba 30 (Poblenou)
📊 Barcelona date of his Spain tour; from €27.50 on La Ganzúa's listing
💶 From €27.50
💬 Argentine rapper from Buenos Aires on his Spanish tour, so expect a largely Argentine crowd singing every line. A mid-size standing room, good with friends. Check the ticket page for availability before going.
https://www.entradas.com/event/homer-el-mero-mero-la-nau-21594472/

2. Barça vs Paris Basketball — EuroLeague
🕘 Tonight 20:30 · 📍 Palau Blaugrana
📊 929 likes on @ordatwins' post about Barça basketball nights
💶 Tickets often from about €20
💬 Barça's basketball team at home in Europe's top competition: a loud indoor arena next to the Camp Nou and an easy group plan. Date and tip-off come from the club site and a ticket listing; confirm when you buy.
https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/tickets

3. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Today · hours not stated · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,365 likes on @planesenbarcelona's round-up; runs 13–29 Nov
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 A bar crawl with a map: you walk between Sant Antoni bars, each serving one special tapa with a drink. It's a plan for friends you already have, not a place to meet people. I couldn't confirm how busy a Tuesday gets.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfpf9i8Dbxl/

4. Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 53 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W hotel with the sea and city below, free on the guest list. The dressier, international option if you want to keep going after dinner on a Tuesday.
https://ra.co/events/2569424

5. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Tuesday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 27 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,192 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 The weekly founders and startup drinks, in English: easy to turn up alone or with a colleague and talk to people building things here. Low-key, and finishes early enough to go on elsewhere.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/316856557/

TOMORROW · Wed 18 Nov

1. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 185 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free midweek house and electronica party at Chica Club with local DJs, and the busiest club listing of the night. A proper late one that costs nothing to try.
https://ra.co/events/2554893

2. Afterwork AperiBarcelona: conoce gente nueva 🍹
🕘 Wed 18:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Sant Antoni
📊 99 guests on Luma
💶 Free
💬 The Italian community's after-work aperitivo in Sant Antoni, built around meeting new people over a spritz. Big for a Wednesday and easy to arrive at alone or in a pair.
https://luma.com/gyu8kuiw

3. Razorlight
🕘 Wed 21:20 · 📍 Sala Wolf, C/ dels Almogàvers 88 (Poblenou)
📊 Listed for 18 Nov by La Ganzúa, Tomaticket and Concerts50
💶 From €30.80
💬 The British indie band behind 'America' and 'Golden Touch' in a small club room: a singalong night for anyone raised on 2000s indie. One listing site also shows 20 Nov, so check the date on your ticket.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/razorlight-barcelona-1016414

4. Storytelling Barcelona – "Courage"
🕘 Wed 19:00 → 21:30 · 📍 El Noa Noa
📊 77 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 706 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 People tell true five-minute stories on this month's theme, courage, to a full bar. English-speaking and friendly, and something different from another round of drinks.
https://www.meetup.com/storytelling-barcelona/events/317013620/

5. AFTERWORK & CONCERT by LEEN LOUD in ART GALLERY-PALACE + TERRACE! LAST OF 2026!
🕘 Wed 20:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Barcelona
📊 43 going on Meetup (limit 50) · group has 474 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 After-work drinks and a live set by Leen Loud in a modernista gallery with a terrace, the last one of the year. Small and sociable, and nearly at its limit, so RSVP early.
https://www.meetup.com/art-galleries-museums-social-events-barcelona/events/317244222/

Scanned: Meetup 257 (partial) · RA 22 · DICE 12 · Xceed 12 · Eventbrite 94 (partial) · Luma 5 · Instagram 31 posts + 22 stories.
